rouencathedral.name: Rouen Cathedral
rouencathedral.slogan: One facade, thirty canvases, and still the light keeps changing.
rouencathedral.line: I am working as hard as I possibly can, and do not even dream of doing anything except the cathedral.
rouencathedral.by: Claude Monet, letter to Durand-Ruel, 30 March 1893

givernymonet.name: Monet's Garden, Giverny
givernymonet.slogan: Step onto the Japanese bridge and into the water lilies.
givernymonet.line: I planted them for pleasure, and grew them without thinking of painting them.
givernymonet.by: Claude Monet, on his water lilies, quoted in Marc Elder, À Giverny, chez Claude Monet, 1924

etretataval.name: Étretat Cliffs
etretataval.slogan: White chalk arches and a needle of rock standing in the sea.
etretataval.line: The Needle rises 70 metres above the sea and starred in Maurice Leblanc's 1909 Arsène Lupin novel The Hollow Needle.

rouengroshorloge.name: Gros-Horloge
rouengroshorloge.slogan: A golden sun keeps time over Rouen's busiest street.
rouengroshorloge.line: Its iron movement dates from 1389, and the Renaissance arch carrying the clock was added in 1529.

jumiegesabbey.name: Jumièges Abbey
jumiegesabbey.slogan: Two white towers stand roofless in a bend of the Seine.
jumiegesabbey.line: The church was consecrated in 1067 in the presence of William the Conqueror, and was left in ruins after the French Revolution.
